meaning.en: For what cause, reason, or purpose. Introducing a complete question. Why is the sky blue?.Why did you do that?.Introducing a verb phrase (bare infinitive clause). Why spend money on something you already get for free?.Why not tell him how you feel?.Introducing a noun or other phrase. Why him? Why not someone taller?.
